summary: Enable the DETERMINISTIC_CANCELLATION_SCOPE_ORDER SDK flag for all new workflows by adding it to WorkflowStateMachines.initialFlags. This flag was added in #2512 to resolve an NDE bug and needs backward compatibility testing to ensure existing workflows aren't affected.
userImpact: Enables automatic use of deterministic cancellation scope ordering for new workflows, reducing non-deterministic execution errors while maintaining backward compatibility.
rootCause: NDE bug in cancellation scope ordering (see #2473) required delayed flag enablement for stability.
proposedFix: Add DETERMINISTIC_CANCELLATION_SCOPE_ORDER flag to WorkflowStateMachines.initialFlags and add tests using raw WorkflowService API to manually poll workflow tasks.
keyQuote: We need to enable `DETERMINISTIC_CANCELLATION_SCOPE_ORDER` flag for all new workflows, by adding it to `WorkflowStateMachines.initialFlags`.
